label: The one supported list of apps and models (R-34). Vince controls this file. Non-flagship tiers are their own entries with their own series (Amendment 11). Which tiers exist at launch follows D-37; entries are added here, never invented by the build.

claude-code.efforts_source: claude --help, version 2.1.270: --effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max). 'default' passes no flag.

codex-cli.efforts_source: codex exec -c model_reasoning_effort=<value>; values low, medium, high. 'default' passes no override.

grok-build.installer_source: Grok Build's own README (installed copy, version 1.0.5), Installation section.
grok-build.efforts_source: grok --help lists --reasoning-effort but not its values; only the app default is listed until the values are read from the vendor.

codex-desktop.installer_source: UNREAD: the official unattended installer for the Codex Windows app has not been read. Runs of this app are refused until it is filled in.

claude-desktop.installer_source: UNREAD: the official unattended installer for the Claude desktop app has not been read. Runs of this app are refused until it is filled in.
